name_story.story: Saira can be understood through the Arabic form سَائِرَة, whose central sense is saira; traveller (feminine). Saira is Arabic سَائِرَة (Sāʾira), the feminine active participle of سَارَ, meaning 'traveller'.

faq.a: Saira is associated with the Arabic form سَائِرَة, whose core sense is saira; traveller (feminine).

faq.q: What is the origin of Saira?
faq.a: Saira is associated with Arabic. Saira is Arabic سَائِرَة (Sāʾira), the feminine active participle of سَارَ, meaning 'traveller'.
Yes — the underlying form سَائِرَة is Arabic.
Saira can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Saira should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Sāʾira is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Saira mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Saira is rendered سائرہ and carries the sense سائرہ، سفر کرنے والی.

faq.q: What does Saira mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Saira is rendered سائره and carries the sense سائره، رهرو.
A romanized syllable approximation is sai-ra. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Saira?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Saira, saira. Script forms are سائره, سائرہ, سَائِرَة, साइरा.

faq.q: Is Saira a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
